Chocobo racing returns to Gold Saucer

By Wedge & Biggs, 12 May

Share on Chirper

After a season away, chocobo racing is back at the Manderville Gold Saucer, with new tracks, new prizes and, for the first time, races open to every grade of bird.

The organisers say the three new courses were designed with long-time racers in mind, and that entry fees stay at 1,000 MGP.

"It's the best the tracks have ever been," said one trainer.

What changes this season

  • Three new tracks: Sagolii Road, Costa del Sol and Tranquil Paths.
  • Weekly cups with MGP prizes.

Races start at 10:00 every day, Eorzea time, and last about three minutes each.
